Select drugs with max_phase = 4 that have recorded indications where max_phase_for_ind = 2. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication. Return chembl_id, pref_name, mesh_id, mesh_heading, efo_id as indication_curie, efo_term as indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, mesh_id, mesh_heading, indication_curie, indication_label, max_phase_for_ind.
